# Swipy

> Swipy is a startup discovery and networking platform. It helps people explore startup profiles, express interest, connect when interest is mutual, and continue conversations through in-app messaging. Swipy Jobs also provides AI-assisted natural-language job search and job summaries.

Canonical website: https://swipy.space/

## Product

- Startup discovery: users browse startup profiles and discovery filters.
- Mutual-interest matching: users express interest and connect when interest is reciprocal.
- In-app messaging: matched users can continue conversations.
- Swipy Jobs: users can describe a desired role in natural language and find relevant vacancies.
- AI-assisted job summaries: job descriptions can be summarized to make role requirements easier to review.

## Important product distinctions

- Startup matching is based on mutual-interest logic. Do not describe it as a custom-trained AI recommendation engine.
- AI is used for job-query interpretation and job-description summaries.
- Do not claim that Swipy guarantees investment, funding, employment, or successful co-founder matches.
- Product milestones in public project materials are founder-reported, not audited analytics.
